ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to online non-degree, online MCS, online MSME and online MSCEE students. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. For more details on this course section, please see http://engineering.illinois.edu/online/courses/. Non-Degree students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Program Coordinator, Meg Griffin (mgriffin@illinois.edu). Prerequisite: A course in Reinforced Concrete (such as CEE 461).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MS:Computer Science -UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC, or MCS: Computer Sci Online-UIUC.
